import json
with open('DATA/products/CoachForce.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

all_relevant = []
for i, msg in enumerate(data['slack']):
    text = msg.get('Message', {}).get('User', {}).get('text', '') or ''
    user_id = msg.get('Message', {}).get('User', {}).get('userId', '')
    channel = msg.get('Channel', {}).get('name', '')
    
    # Look for documents/MR report mentions
    if 'market_research' in text or 'CoFoAIX' in text or 'MR Report' in text or 'Review' in text or 'review the document' in text.lower() or 'cofoaix_market' in text.lower():
        # Skip simple blog shares
        if text.startswith('@here') and len(text) < 100:
            continue
        all_relevant.append((i, channel, user_id, text))

for i, ch, uid, t in all_relevant[:30]:
    print(f'[{i}][{ch}][{uid}]: {t[:300]}')
    print('---')
EOF
